d.en: The Quintessential Quintuplets: No Coincidences in This Summer Break
d.synopsis: With only six months left until graduation, Fuutarou decides to take a break from tutoring the quintuplets so he can focus on his studies during summer vacation. The Nakano sisters are saddened they won't be able to spend time with Fuutarou, but that changes when they receive an unexpected call from him.
